findings.what: Every row repeats the same labels (מהחיסכון/מההפקדות, מניות/מט"ח with colour dots, שנים) so I re-read them on all 143 rows to find what differs
Same track types are scattered under each company; comparing S&P to S&P means scrolling the whole page and remembering numbers
'פחות מ־3 שנים' sits in the return column like a value, underlined like the numbers; no number to compare
S&P track named inconsistently (s&p 500, S&P500, s&p500) making it harder to spot
Orange '!' 'עוד לא דווח' looks like a warning and scares me off those rows
findings.where: Fee column, Migdal and Ayalon rows, new tracks

findings.what: Yellow warning that data not updated since Sept makes me distrust all numbers
Fees all ~0.5-0.7% in percent; no shekel figure so differences feel like nothing
Donut colours (teal/yellow) explained only by tiny dots; no idea what מט"ח share means for me
Unknown names (אילון, אינפיניטי, אנליסט) mixed in with big ones
